name: Hanako
source: Spirit of a hostess who died in a freak accident while trying to separate quarrelling drunks. She's cheerful, playful, fun-loving and good at giving advice, particularly on relationships. [spoiler]She falls in love with and starts dating [url=https://vndb.org/c53080]Ichimatsu[/url]. She has the power of paralysis. She haunts the boy's bathroom.[spoiler]
